title: splitwithnamespace router
description: Like split, with an xpath that may use the namespace prefix nsprefix: splits the body into parts and sends each part along the outbound link with rule split; the message itself continues on the other link.

nsprefix.description: The prefix of the xpath that stands for namespace

namespace.title: Namespace
namespace.description: The namespace of the prefix nsprefix
